title: Plan
description: A unit of approved work. Authored by the local planning client, re-validated by the orchestrator at submission. Baseline v0.1 section 6.

goal.description: What this plan is for, in the operator's words.

assumptions.description: Echoed to the operator at the approval gate. At least one is mandatory (goal G2).

env.description: Selects the target worker VM for the whole plan.

success_criteria.description: Declarative checks evaluated by the orchestrator at finalize.

egress.description: Hostnames this plan's sandboxes may reach through the supervisor proxy, on top of the standing set (Gitea, package registries). Plan-scoped, shown at the approval gate, and cannot widen after approval. Empty means deny everything outside the standing set.

max_cost_microusd.description: Ceiling on what this whole plan may cost, in millionths of a US dollar, across every task and every execution attempt. Required: unlike a token ceiling it cannot be inferred from the tasks, because nothing here holds a price table. The orchestrator halts the plan rather than dispatching a task that would cross it.

env_ttl_min.description: Wall-clock lifetime of the plan environment before the supervisor tears it down.

projectRef.description: An existing project by id, or a new project by name.

name.description: Also the Gitea repository name, so it is slug-shaped.

egressHost.description: A lowercase hostname, optionally prefixed with `*.` to cover subdomains. No scheme, port, or path: the proxy matches on the CONNECT host and allows 80/443 only.

taskId.description: Plan-local identifier. Distinct from the database UUID assigned at submission.

description.description: Plain text. v1 carries no typed context capsule; large inputs live in the repo.

cost_microusd.description: Ceiling on what this task may cost, in millionths of a US dollar, task-wide across every execution attempt. Enforced by the agent as the SDK's per-run budget. The maximum ($5.00) is a sizing convenience derived from published Opus 5 rates for a roughly 500k-token task, not a hard economic claim.

path.description: Repo-relative path in plan/<id>. No leading slash, no parent traversal.
